unit.title: A Cultural Story: The Farmer and His Sons

contentBlocks.text: ਪਿਛਲੇ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਬਾਰੇ ਲਿਖਿਆ। ਇਸ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ! (Last week you wrote about your family. This week, read an old cultural story!)

This week's story is about a farmer. Learn 5 new words you'll need: ਕਿਸਾਨ (farmer), ਖੇਤ (field), ਪੁੱਤਰ (son), ਖ਼ਜ਼ਾਨਾ (treasure), and ਮਿਹਨਤ (hard work). Practice using ਕਿਸਾਨ and ਖੇਤ in one sentence of your own: describe a farmer working in a field.
ਤੁਸੀਂ ਨਵੇਂ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਸਿੱਖੇ! (You just learned new words!) Tomorrow we'll read the real story using them.

objectives: Learn 5 new vocabulary words needed for this week's cultural story: ਕਿਸਾਨ/ਖੇਤ/ਪੁੱਤਰ/ਖ਼ਜ਼ਾਨਾ/ਮਿਹਨਤ
Use ਕਿਸਾਨ and ਖੇਤ correctly in an original sentence
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review last week's family-vocabulary paragraph briefly.
2. Introduce this week's 5 new words.
3. Have the child build a sentence using ਕਿਸਾਨ and ਖੇਤ.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's story, which uses this week's full vocabulary.
differentiationTips: Struggling: focus on just ਕਿਸਾਨ and ਖੇਤ first, since they're the story's two most central words
Ready for more: ask the child to predict what the story might be about, based only on this week's 5 vocabulary words
This lesson directly sets up the course's 'cultural stories' description, previewing vocabulary before the story itself
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a vocabulary-acquisition activity — check that the child correctly traces/writes all 5 new words and builds a real sentence using ਕਿਸਾਨ and ਖੇਤ together.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses the course's 'vocabulary expansion' and 'cultural stories' goals together, pre-teaching key vocabulary before this week's real story.

generationData.instructions: Trace each word, then copy it once on your own.
